channel.title: Ebenezer Tarubinga: papers
channel.description: Papers by Ebenezer Tarubinga on semi-supervised semantic segmentation, each dated by its first posting on arXiv.

item.title: CW-BASS v2: Saturation-Aware Pseudo-Label Selection for Semi-Supervised Segmentation under Foundation-Model Teachers
item.description: A reliability gate for pseudo-label selection, evaluated across six DINOv2 teacher settings with 5% held-out calibration, on DINOv2-Base (ViT-B/14) with DPT-lite. arXiv:2608.12773 (2026)

item.title: PixCon: Clean-Positive Contrastive Learning for Foundation-Model Semi-Supervised Segmentation
item.description: A clean-positive pixel-contrastive branch with 256 entries per class and τ=0.1. The contrastive head is training-only and adds no inference-time parameters. arXiv:2607.03068 (2026), under review

item.title: FARCLUSS: Fuzzy Adaptive Rebalancing and Contrastive Uncertainty Learning for Semi-Supervised Semantic Segmentation
item.description: Top-K fuzzy labels, entropy-based uncertainty weighting, adaptive class rebalancing and a 128-D prototype-contrastive head, with ResNet-101 at 1/8 labeled data. Neural Networks, vol. 205, article 109494

item.title: CW-BASS: Confidence-Weighted Boundary-Aware Learning for Semi-Supervised Semantic Segmentation
item.description: A confidence-weighted pseudo-label loss, adaptive thresholding and Sobel boundary supervision, targeting confirmation bias, noisy pseudo-labels and limited-label learning. IEEE IJCNN 2025, DOI 10.1109/IJCNN64981.2025.11227871
